steps.title: Condition on n
steps.body: $4 \mid n(n-1)$. Since $n$ and $n-1$ have opposite parity, one of them must be divisible by 4: $n \equiv 0$ or $1 \pmod 4$.

steps.body: RFC 1323/7323 limits the shift count to 14, so the largest window is $65535 \times 2^{14}$ bytes (about 1 GB).
